title: Christoph's Feedback: Can your business idea make it? LISBOA LIVE!
description: OFFLINE & LIVE IN LISBON/ LISBOA! 19.00 LISBON TIME. Hosted by business angel, author, and mentor Christoph Raethke (https://www.christophr.de), "Christoph's Feedback" is Berlin's only meetup where you will be positively challenged about founding a startup - or get actionable tips on how to get it financed. Too often, founders work on ideas that can never make it, no matter how passionate they are. Problems might be a twisted market, wrong perception of user needs, the fact that it has been tried x times before and always failed, and many other caveats that are best identified BEFORE starting to put serious effort into an idea. That's why "Christoph's Feedback" is a monthly event to either a) show and tell your startup or product idea in order to get tough feedback BEFORE you begin to seriously put work and money into it or start fundraising. The feedback you get might either be a strong suggestion to reconsider or even fold your idea - or highly valuable advice on the next most useful steps to turn it into reality. There's no need for you to prepare a slide deck or follow any "elevator pitch" rule; just tell us what you're working on or b) come as a guest to hear what other founders in Berlin are working on, learn how to discover critical challenges and questions about ideas yourself, and maybe even join the team of an idea you particularly like. The feedback you get will be powerful and meaningful, guaranteed.

title: Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social
description: Join us for the **Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social**—a relaxed, welcoming gathering designed for anyone in Lisbon’s vibrant startup and professional community who wants to connect beyond the usual business talk. Hosted by Richard Lucas and the friendly Open Coffee Lisbon team, this event is all about genuine conversations, new friendships, and building a supportive network in a laid-back atmosphere. Many of our current event participants head out for lunch to hang out after our sell out morning meetings. We decided to offer a more social event in fabulous setting. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, student, creative, tourist, or simply curious, you’ll find a space where everyone is encouraged to mingle, share stories, and discover common interests. Our events are open and welcoming to people from all backgrounds and ages. Many different nationalities come together at our events, as well as long term Lisbon residents. Our motto "we welcome all, who welcome all." **This is not a speed dating/pickup type event. Everyone who attends is entitled to feel safe, not be harassed or pressured.** **EVENT STRUCTURE:** We will have a structured first sixty minutes with icebreakers aimed at making things easy for people to connect with one another. Then participants are welcome to hang out and socialise as they wish after the structured part of the meeting is over. **REACH OUT:** If you have a community initiative you want to share or announce, let us know in advance. **VOLUNTEERS** We need volunteers to help us develop the project. From simple things like being early to welcome people, through to PR and graphic design and a website. Let us know if that sounds like you and apply to join the team [here](https://forms.gle/EeLboZcYBrLesVt26) Newcomers are especially welcome, and if you’re feeling shy, don't worry. you’re free to listen or join in at your own pace. Bring your ideas, your curiosity, and your favourite conversation starters. Share your LinkedIn or project links with the group, and let’s help each other grow—personally and professionally.
